title: VAST 12-journal dashboard — ArtCraft single-page design specification

basis.observedCurrentStructure: The entry page currently has separate hash-routed overview, trends, journals, updates, and detail panels; overview and trends also contain publication and citation charts. The catalog is currently a table, and the numbered source list is in the updates panel. This specification consolidates the public dashboard into one continuous page and defines additional catalog and per-journal chart presentation.

sectionOrder.title: VAST-1 CiteScore Matrix Table (2015–2025 + Tracker 2026) & Overview Charts
content: VAST-1 CiteScore matrix table with annual CiteScore columns 2015–2025 and a 2026 Tracker column
Overview charts for the VAST-1 CiteScore/Tracker series
Keep the official CiteScore annual series and current-year Tracker visibly distinct

sectionOrder.title: 12-Journal Catalog with Official Covers & Publisher/Institute Logos
content: A 4-column by 3-row hero/catalog grid containing all 12 journals
Each journal entry includes its official cover image and the relevant publisher or institute logo
Journal identity and publisher/institute attribution must be explicit and linked to evidence

specialPublisherMapping.institute: Viện Toán học (Institute of Mathematics, VAST)

sectionOrder.title: Numbered Reference List ([1]..[12])
sectionOrder.content: The 12 official journal and publisher/institute references, presented as a numbered list [1] through [12]. Each item links to its authoritative source.

journalDetailRoute.description: A dedicated per-journal detail view on the same page, addressable by journal id; provide a visible route back to the catalog.

charts.label: Chart A
charts.title: Annual published papers & issues
charts.yearRange: From the journal's actual earliest year of publication in available source data through 2026, inclusive.
charts.rangeRule: Determine the lower bound separately for each journal from its earliest actual publication record; do not impose a 2020 lower bound. The year 2026 may be year-to-date and must be marked as such when coverage is incomplete.

charts.label: Chart B
charts.title: Annual citations
charts.yearRange: From the earliest citation year available for that journal through 2026, inclusive.
charts.rangeRule: Determine the lower bound from that journal's actual earliest citation-year record; do not impose a shared 2020 lower bound. Distinguish verified annual counts from year-to-date or incomplete coverage.

charts.label: Chart C
charts.title: CiteScore and Tracker / projected four-year CiteScore
charts.vast1: Show the official annual CiteScore history and the 2026 CiteScore Tracker as a distinct current-year observation.
charts.vast2: Show the projected four-year CiteScore series, clearly labeled as a locally calculated projection rather than an official Scopus CiteScore.

typography.fallbacks: Use appropriate sans-serif fallbacks while preserving the specified font roles.

borders.application: Use consistent thin grid lines to define tables, cards, and section divisions; avoid rounded, soft-card styling.

rightMarginRuler.placement: Fixed to or aligned with the right edge of the page composition

sectionBadges.use: Numbered section or journal markers, retaining two-digit zero-padded labels.

examples: 01 / VAST-1 CITESCORE MATRIX TABLE & OVERVIEW CHARTS

dataAndPresentationRules.catalogLayout: 4 columns × 3 rows on desktop; preserve the complete 12-journal sequence responsively.
dataAndPresentationRules.officialAssets: Use official cover images and publisher/institute logos; retain source attribution for each asset.
metricIntegrity: Do not present a projected VAST-2 value as an official Scopus CiteScore.
Label 2026 values as Tracker or year-to-date where applicable.
Do not truncate journal-specific historical charts to 2020–2026 when earlier records are available.

references.linkRequirement: Each numbered citation must link to an official journal website or authoritative publisher/institute record.
